messages.body_plain:
We’re excited to announce that the 2027 Immcantation Users Group Meeting will take place on January 21st, 2027 — and we hope you'll join us!

This annual event brings together researchers, developers, and users to share insights, learn about recent developments, and connect around all things Immcantation and Adaptive Immune Receptor Repertoire (AIRR) analysis.

📅 Date: January 21st, 2027 (from 10:00am to 1:30pm ET)
📍 Location: Virtual (Zoom)
🗓️ Registration and abstract submission opens: September 1st, 2026

Stay tuned! Visit https://immcantation.github.io/users-meeting/2027 <https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimmcantation.github.io%2Fusers-meeting%2F2027&data=05%...%40yale.edu%7Cc9353b969d6e4838306108defed42119%7Cdd8cbebb21394df8b4114e3e87abeb5c%7C0%7C0%7C639228384209865674%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=K%2BAYYiAt5AeGrCwGvs2PIcd8tqrmogDxMgWHW0pbwao%3D&reserved=0> for updated information, including registration, agenda, and abstract submission deadlines.

We look forward to seeing you there!

Warm regards,
The Immcantation Team
